input.video_prompt: One continuous cinematic shot in exactly the same hand-painted 2D cartoon style as the image. The toad villain on the right speaks every word of the audio with his wide mouth in exact lip-sync. On "Mwa-ha-ha-ha!" he throws his head back and laughs. The red panda seen from behind on the left braces against the wind and keeps facing him. The camera stays still.
